test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'these'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given blank needs a determiner to clarify the following noun alveoli. 
 
• Alveoli is a plural noun and so we can negate **this **and **that **as they are used with singular nouns. 
 
• The word **these** is used to denote more than one object that is near to the speaker. The word **those **is used to denote more than one object that is far from the speaker.
 
• Since, alveoli are inside a person's body, we need to use **these. **
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - Oxygen fuels our living processes. It contracts our muscles, helps our cells to work, grow and regenerate, (1) feeds our brains, calms our nerves, helps the heart to pump, fights infection and (2) boosts immunity," says Dr Narendra Nath Jena, Director, Institute of Emergency Medicine, MMH R Centre, Madurai. Once air enters the nose or mouth, it gets humidified and reaches (3)** the **alveoli. The alveoli are tiny air sacs that help to (4) **pull in **oxygen and transfer it into the blood stream and also to pull out the carbon dioxide and push it out of the lungs. COVID-19 destroys (5)** these **alveoli by thickening the walls so gas exchange becomes difficult.*
